name: specz
description: Efficient, lightweight spec-driven workflow plugin with disciplined clarification, impact-aware planning, traceable tasks, verification evidence, bounded run loops, and archive history.

interface.shortDescription: Run efficient, lightweight spec-driven workflows through one flow entry.
interface.longDescription: Specz helps agents select or create a bundle, route by task size, clarify behavior with focused questions, plan larger work with impact-aware existing-code analysis, run implementation and independent verification in bounded loops, and archive completed work.
defaultPrompt: Use specz-flow to decide the next Specz step for this task.
Use specz-flow to resume the active spec bundle.
Use specz-clarify to create or update the behavior spec.
Use specz-plan to prepare concise design, tasks, and verification evidence.
Use specz-run to implement, verify, and repair the active bundle.
Use specz-archive to archive a passed bundle.
